chunk_text: The treatment plant consists of preliminary treatment including bar screens and grit removal, followed by primary sedimentation tanks.
Secondary treatment is provided by activated sludge process with aeration basins and final clarifiers.
The facility employs biological nutrient removal (BNR) including nitrification and denitrification zones.
Disinfection is achieved using ultraviolet (UV) light prior to discharge.
Sludge is treated through anaerobic digestion followed by dewatering using centrifuges.
The permit requires monthly monitoring of effluent parameters.
Financial assurance requirements are detailed in Section 7.
